PowerShell(npx supabase db query --linked "select pol.polname as policy_name, pol.polcmd as cmd, pg_get_expr\(pol.polqual, pol.polrelid\) as using_expr, pg_get_expr\(pol.polwithcheck, pol.polrelid\) as with_check, c.relrowsecurity as rls_enabled, c.relforcerowsecurity as rls_forced from pg_policy pol join pg_class c on c.oid = pol.polrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where n.nspname='scheduling' and c.relname='substitutions';")

PowerShell(npx supabase db query --linked "select st.id, st.full_name, st.role, st.max_periods, count\(ts.subject_id\) as qual_count from public.staff st left join scheduling.teacher_subjects ts on ts.teacher_id=st.id group by st.id, st.full_name, st.role, st.max_periods order by st.full_name;")

PowerShell(npx supabase db query --linked "select ts.teacher_id, st.full_name, sub.name as subject_name, sub.class_id, sub.id as subject_id from scheduling.teacher_subjects ts join public.staff st on st.id=ts.teacher_id join academic.subjects sub on sub.id=ts.subject_id order by st.full_name, sub.name;")

PowerShell(npx supabase db query --linked "select t.slot_id, ts.day, ts.period_number, st.full_name, sub.name as subject_name, t.class_id from scheduling.timetable t join scheduling.time_slots ts on ts.id=t.slot_id join public.staff st on st.id=t.teacher_id join academic.subjects sub on sub.id=t.subject_id where ts.day='mon' order by t.slot_id, st.full_name;")
